g.text: Generated disclosure · verbatim
Implementation and performance are monitored using social indicators including workforce composition by
age, gender and geographical area; women’s representation among the top 10% of management; recruitment
and departures; sickness and workplace-accident absenteeism; workplace-accident frequency and severity
rates; training hours per employee; employees with disabilities; and collective agreements signed.
